description: Defines the ProvenanceEvidence vertex schema, attachment rules, confidence semantics, and traceability conventions for the hypertension knowledge graph. Every extracted knowledge node must be traceable back to a specific transcript utterance via this spec.

fields.description: The verbatim quote or a faithful paraphrase from the transcript that directly justifies the extracted node or edge. Must be specific enough that a human reviewer can locate it in the raw transcript. Do not invent or generalize — copy from the TranscriptEpisode verbatimText.
fields.good_example: If the patient is already on two drugs and BP is still above 140/90, I always add a third agent before considering secondary causes.

fields.description: The ID of the TranscriptEpisode vertex this evidence was extracted from. Must match an existing TranscriptEpisode ID in the graph.
Who made the statement. Use one of the allowed values only.
ISO-8601 datetime or relative offset within the session (e.g. '00:14:32'). Include when available from session metadata.
The LLM extractor's confidence that the extracted node/edge faithfully represents the expert's stated intent.

confidence_definitions.high: The expert stated this directly and unambiguously. The traceText is a near-verbatim quote.
confidence_definitions.medium: The expert implied this clearly but did not state it word-for-word. The traceText is a faithful paraphrase.
confidence_definitions.low: The expert gestured toward this idea but did not elaborate. The extraction involves moderate interpretation.
confidence_definitions.inferred: The node or edge was derived from multiple statements across the session rather than one utterance. The traceText summarizes the reasoning.

attachment_rules.rule: EVERY extracted knowledge vertex must have at least one outgoing edge to a ProvenanceEvidence vertex in the same delta as the extraction.
attachment_rules.failure_description: A knowledge vertex without its label-specific provenance edge is rejected and returned to the extractor for correction.

reuse_rules.description: A single ProvenanceEvidence node may support multiple knowledge vertices extracted from the same utterance.
reuse_rules.rule: If two or more vertices are extracted from the same TranscriptEpisode in the same delta, emit ONE ProvenanceEvidence vertex and link all knowledge vertices to it. Do not emit duplicate ProvenanceEvidence nodes for the same source episode within a single delta.
reuse_rules.exception: If two vertices from the same episode have meaningfully different justifications (different sub-sentences), emit separate ProvenanceEvidence nodes with distinct sequence numbers.

cross_section_provenance.description: When a vertex created in an earlier section is enriched with new edges in a later section (e.g. a HypertensionConcept from Section B gains a treatedWith edge in Section C), a NEW ProvenanceEvidence node must be emitted for the enriching turn — even though the concept vertex itself already exists.
cross_section_provenance.rule: The ProvenanceEvidence node always traces the specific delta in which the edge was added, not the delta in which the vertex was first created.

inferred_provenance.description: Some knowledge nodes are synthesized across multiple utterances (e.g. a DecisionRule assembled from three separate statements). These require a special inferred provenance record.
inferred_provenance.rule: Set confidence='inferred'. In traceText, name at least two contributing episode IDs and summarize the synthesis.
inferred_provenance.sourceEpisode: Set to the episode ID of the most recent contributing utterance.

id_convention.sequence: Zero-padded 2-digit integer starting at 01, incrementing per ProvenanceEvidence node emitted within the same episode.

checks.name: traceText_not_empty
checks.description: ProvenanceEvidence.traceText must not be an empty string.

checks.name: sourceEpisode_exists
checks.description: ProvenanceEvidence.sourceEpisode must match an existing TranscriptEpisode ID in the vertex cache.

checks.name: speaker_allowed_value
checks.description: ProvenanceEvidence.speaker must be one of: expert, interviewer, system.

checks.name: confidence_allowed_value
checks.description: If confidence is present, it must be one of: high, medium, low, inferred.

checks.name: no_duplicate_prov_same_delta
checks.description: Within a single delta, two ProvenanceEvidence nodes must not share the same sourceEpisode and traceText.
